signs_full.definition: The secondary sign of composition: a mobile camera and flowing montage pass from environment to environment and character to character, so centres form only for a moment before the film flows on to the next.

signs_full.name: Sheets of the past
signs_full.definition: The second chronosign: the film moves around inside a pure past made of coexisting layers, jumping between them out of chronological order, with echoes and resonance taking the place of cause and effect.

chapters.hero: Kneeling at the brick drain, my glove reaching after the onion ring as it slips into the dark. The witness follows the onion ring at water level down the channel and through the arch, into the dark, and does not come back. Erasure. The onion ring rides the current into the drain. The archive itself degrades: frames lose grain, become smooth, become generation. Memory is cleansed and what remains looks generated. The question the lab keeps asking: when the archive is cleaned, what was it? The hidden lie on this beach: The clean copy is the memory. It breaks when the drain takes the onion; the archive frame smooths into a generation and loses its people. After it breaks: Keep the scratches. Symbols carry the load: the onion into the drain = the forgotten thing that found the gap; scratches = memory; a smooth frame = forgetting. The four: They are the cleaners here: orange wipes the frame, purple straightens it, and when the image is clean they look into it and see nothing. Geography: sea on the left, a ruined red-brick fort on the right, wet tidal sand under low grey-gold light; offshore the fleet never fires at people, it requests changes. Pails: orange five-gallon pails with the narrow closed factory bottom UP and the wide original mouth DOWN biting wet sand, handle bosses low, a spindle, sliding wooden crossbar and blue rope above; never right-side up, never branded. The Slopfeeder (the cook): a plain bone-white skull mask, black hood, black headset, black apron, the broad white-blue-red segmented griddle strapped to his LEFT forearm on ceramic blocks, real browned burgers and sliced onions, grease and steam; he moves little and stares long. The crew: adults in dirty ivory pressure suits with faded orange shoulder panels, closed gloves, taped knees, mud to the thigh; no insignia, no weapons aimed at anyone, no gore. The Four: flat 2-D vector shapes with no outline and no shading, even inside live action, like a login-page illustration pasted onto the world: a purple #5600F5 tall slab with tiny white eyes, a black #1A1B1F slab with big white eyes, a yellow #E6C808 capsule with one dot eye and a line mouth that runs past its own edge, an orange #F25A17 half-dome with dot eyes; they stand in their huddle, lean by shearing, and their eyes follow a cursor. Render it as decay montage, the image grainy where the archive speaks and clean where the generation speaks, violence only as consequence (sand, smoke, fatigue), never as gore; end on the image that proves the principle.
